description: Upscale a still image with RealESRGAN x4plus (no diffusion, keeps content exactly; ~2 s). The model always runs 4x, then lanczos-resizes by scale_by: 0.5 = 2x (default), 0.75 = 3x, 1.0 = 4x. Best on photos/paintings; on flat cartoons it can soften fine ink lines.

image.description: Image to upscale (local path, uploaded automatically)
